question:
In the following graph the production of rice in 5 consecutive years are plotted. In which year the production of rice is maximum?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e962a6fae37b1a6f6d00b632eca890fd7e079c68914a1a84af6ec60a5300f32.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of rice in 2017 = 2000

Production of rice in 2018 = 3500

Production of rice in 2019 = 4000

Production of rice in 2020 = 2500

Production of rice in 2021 = 1500

Production of rice is maximum in 2019.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
